scenes.text: Imagine standing in a fifty-square-mile strip of wild land inside Yellowstone National Park where you could theoretically commit the perfect crime and walk away completely free.
Due to a highly bizarre loophole in the United States Constitution, any federal crime committed in this specific Idaho portion of the park must be tried by a jury from both that state and district.
But because the official population of this area is absolutely zero, a legal constitutional jury cannot be formed and a federal trial can never actually happen.
Congress has known about this terrifying zone of death for decades but has failed to fix it, so would you ever dare to camp in this lawless territory? Tell me in the comments and subscribe for more.
